service.description: Marriage registration and certificate; the couple and the witnesses visit the office on the given date.
service.depending: Aadhaar Card and age proof of the bride and the groom, Aadhaar Card of 3 witnesses, marriage invitation card, marriage photos, certificate of the priest
service.rules: The bride must be 18 or older and the groom 21 or older. The couple and the witnesses go to the office together.
